assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a high resolution, fully finished, two-page illustrated monster field-journal spread used as a flat texture on a 3D book in a cinematic website. Create the artwork itself, NOT a mockup or photograph of a physical book. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. Two equally sized upright portrait pages directly beside one another, with the exact vertical gutter at x=50%. Fill the whole image with warm golden, heavily aged parchment, irregular foxing, stains, browned corners, frayed edge texture, faded ink, paper fibers. Both pages are flat, front-facing, no perspective, no hands, no surroundings, no cover, no drop shadow, no white frame. All text English only. Visual language of an eccentric supernatural research journal: very large irregular hand-lettered black headings, confident expressive sepia pen and ink creature illustrations, dense crosshatching and watercolor washes, many smaller observations in neat but imperfect handwriting, red marginal sigils, cryptic symbols, underlined warnings, hand-drawn arrows and anatomy callouts. Dense artful composition with lots of detail and personality, sketches and annotations fill BOTH pages. No modern typesetting, no sparse generic diagram, no empty cream margins. Each page is about 3:4 aspect ratio. Use several readable, SHORT notes rather than fake paragraphs. Keep important text away from the central gutter and image edges. No Cyrillic, watermark, screenshots, or UI.
